title: The Migration in November and December
excerpt: In November and December the short rains bring the herds back south through the eastern and central Serengeti.
body:
With the short rains in November and December, the herds leave the north and move south again.

## Where the herds are

They move through the eastern and central Serengeti towards the southern plains. Movements depend on rain.

## Weather

Short afternoon showers, green landscapes, warm days.

## Advantages

- Quieter than the peak months.
- Good wildlife in central Serengeti.
- Birdlife with migratory species.

## Christmas

The holiday period is busy again. See [Christmas and New Year in Tanzania](/blog/tanzania-at-christmas/).

## Combine

With Zanzibar, which is mostly dry in December.

Read our [safari in November](/safari-in-tanzania-in-november/) page or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
